title: security(rbac-v2): fix audit logging + KMS region pinning enforcement for RBAC v2
author: Sophie Kim
release_notes: Fix: Audit events now reliably include KMS key id and region when RBAC v2 data-residency rules are evaluated. Enforcement: Correct residency enforcement when KMS region pinning is enabled; existing resources are migrated to include region metadata. Backwards compatible behind feature flag.
description: Motivation: customers using RBAC v2 with KMS region pinning reported missing or incomplete KMS metadata in audit logs and occasional policy misses when data-residency constraints were evaluated. This caused false-allow situations for resources that should have been blocked by KMS region pinning. Summary: 1) Enrich audit events with kms_key_id and kms_key_region at the point of policy evaluation and audit emission. 2) Fix policy engine residency checks to consult resource KMS region consistently across all code paths. 3) Add a migration to backfill kms_region for existing resources that already specify a key ARN. 4) Add a feature flag rbac_v2_kms_region_enforce to gate the rollout and allow canary. Implementation notes: - Introduced pkg/kms/residency.go which canonicalizes key identifiers and derives region reliably from key ARN and customer config. - Audit producer now attaches kms.metadata.kms_key_id and kms.metadata.kms_key_region to structured audit events emitted by services/audit/producer.go. - Policy engine (services/rbac/policy_engine.go) now uses the canonical region from pkg/kms/residency.go instead of the runtime default when evaluating residency rules. - Migration migration/2025_02_12_add_kms_region_to_audit.sql backfills kms_region for resources where key_arn is present. - Added integration tests tests/integration/rbac_kms_region_test.go and unit tests for the residency logic. - Docs updated docs/rbac/kms-region-pinning.md and console config chart updated. Checklist: [x] unit tests added [x] integration tests added [x] migration and rollback tested [x] docs updated [x] feature-flag gated rollout Testing: manual canary with feature-flag on in staging, repro of previously failing tenant case, CI run. Rollout plan: enable feature flag in a small set of tenants for 48h, monitor audit events and policy denies metric. If regressions observed, toggle flag off and revert migration via documented rollback which removes kms_region and reverts policy behavior.
